description: Second brain: load past notes at session start, remind to record at the end of a turn.

hooks.command: f="$HOME/second-brain/bin/brain.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] && node "$f" hook codex session-start || echo '{}'
f="$HOME/second-brain/bin/brain.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] && node "$f" hook codex stop || echo '{}'
